name: Spherical 3R on fold-frontier axes
verdict: screened, the best plain spherical 3R so far (0 passive translations, 0 cuff slides): 44.72 at q 0.98 (score 83.7; near-touch gap 53.66, metal 0.00 mm in 8 poses) and 49.03 at q 1.0 (score 82.2, near-touch clean), vs 51.33 at rail-elbow k2221's axes and 65.05 / 68.93 at the champion's; not 90+. The fold frontier does not transfer to a concurrent chain: the 792 frontier seeds score 74.4-170 (median 118) because the fold-free J1 / J2 rays run inside the arm / trunk (hub parking, tools/fold_parking.py), and CMA walks every frontier start back to J1 over the acromion; gate converged over 4790 CMA tries (0.60 / 0.29 / 0.01 score pts). Frozen Bench(110,360) exact: 57.99 at k2221's axes (51.33 fast), 60.03 at k1530's; CMA bests pending on the farm
limiter: hub 2 0 % in band at every axis set (F 145-154 mm, posterolateral horizontal: its GH ray has no level near the skin in every pose) and link 2 5-10 % (median 116 mm, lifted by plane 0 elev 60 axial -60 on a posterior-medial ray); overhead (elev >= 140) reach 0.42-0.50 (J2 fold); with zero slides every axis must pass through GH, so the morphology has no freedom left
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, kit checks (march, dense K2, K6, audit) + hub crown / wall skin check, near-touch and overhead reports (model file); 5636 configs: 792 frontier seeds (frontier.json a1+a2 85-140 x sigma +-1, farm), 54 q / width variants + controls (template reproduced: 65.05 / 69.29 / 51.97 / 51.33), 6 farm CMA streams (A, B, D from the frontier, E, G from k1530 / k2221, F with q free; 4790 tries); crown check: 47 % of frontier configs had taken poses with a hub crown or wall inside the skin although every face was clear
bench: Bench(60,160) fast grid, kit checks (march, dense K2, K6) + crown/wall skin check

gate.order: by generation (the 6 streams ran in parallel)

mechanism.notes: plain spherical 3R on fold-frontier axes (template build). bodies: link 1, link 2, arm-end (member 3: hub-3 plate + K7 neck rigid on BOTTOM); joints: J1, J2, J3 O20 hubs (MR117-2RS pair each). Bench has no GH translation: no cuff slide modelled; on a body the user's cuff slides under BOTTOM (outside the DOF count) or the liner take GH slip - if counted, +2 passive_trans, crossed. The model claims 0 mm liner compliance. custom: base, 2 straps, arm-end plate + neck, 3 hub shafts (est.); catalogue 3 x MR117 pair.
